title: traveler_creation_with_duplicate_phone_protection
description: Test creating a traveler with a unique phone_lookup_key to receive 201 and verify DB-first ID generation. Then attempt to create another traveler with the same phone_lookup_key and expect a 409 or validation error to ensure duplicate traveler protection.

title: traveler_document_upload_and_access_control
description: Test uploading allowed image or PDF documents with safe filenames to a traveler and expect 201 with stored document metadata. Attempt to upload documents with path traversal filenames or disallowed file types and expect 400 or 415 errors. Also, verify that accessing documents not belonging to the traveler returns 403 or 404 errors.

title: trip_inventory_filter_and_persistence
description: Test GET /trips/ with valid filter parameters and expect 200 with filtered trip inventory. Access trip detail via GET /trips/<id> and verify capacity fields. Return to trip list with the same query string and confirm filter persistence. Test invalid filter values to receive 400 validation error and non-existent trip detail to receive 404.

title: booking_draft_creation_and_search
description: Test creating booking drafts with required fields and expect 201. Search bookings by booking ID, traveler name, trip name, notes, source, or traveler ID and expect 200 with matching results. Verify booking event/history retrieval returns 200 with correct entries.

title: booking_status_update_and_history_trail
description: Test PATCH /bookings/<id> to update payment or booking status with valid transitions and expect 200. Verify that invalid status transitions return 400 or 409 errors. Confirm booking event/history trail appends new entries after updates.

title: lead_creation_search_and_handoff
description: Test creating leads with valid data and expect 201. Search leads with partial text and expect 200 with matched records. Create human handoff from a lead and expect 201 with pending handoff item. Verify blacklisted traveler/contact data leads to 400 or blocked response. Confirm 404 on handoff creation for non-existent leads.

title: interaction_log_search_with_filters
description: Test GET /interactions/ with various filters (traveler, lead, booking, keyword) and expect 200 with matching logs. Test invalid filter syntax to receive 400 validation error. Confirm empty result set returns 200 when no matches found.

title: handoff_queue_status_transitions_and_counts
description: Test GET /admin/handoffs/ returns 200 with kanban board grouped by status. Verify GET /admin/handoffs/pending returns the current pending count. Test PATCH /admin/handoffs/<id> to move items through Pending, In Progress, and Resolved statuses with 200 responses. Confirm invalid status transitions return 400 or 409 and 404 for missing handoff IDs.

title: admin_dashboard_and_health_endpoints
description: Test GET /admin/ returns 200 with dashboard summary. Verify GET /admin/db-health returns 200 with database health diagnostics and 503 or error on connectivity failure. Test import/sync issue views and duplicate identity review endpoints return 200 with expected data.

title: identity_resolution_duplicate_scan_and_merge
description: Test GET /api/crm/duplicates returns 200 with duplicate candidates or an empty list. Test POST /api/crm/resolve-identity with valid source and alias IDs returns 200 with successful merge. Verify invalid or missing IDs return 400, 404, or 422 errors depending on the validation branch. Confirm merged traveler data reflects in GET /travelers/.
